p: flee when no man pursueth: Because their own conscience accuses them.
many are its princes: The state of the commonwealth is often changed.
it for him that will pity: For God will take away the wicked usurer, and give his goods to him that will bestow them well.
abomination: Because it is not of faith which is grounded on God's word or law which the wicked contemn.
him out: And judge that he is not wise.
is hidden: He is known by his doings to be wicked.
feareth always: Which stands in awe of God, and is afraid to offend him.
a wicked ruler over the poor: For he can never be satisfied but always oppresses and spoils.
sustain him: No one will be able to deliver him.
bread that man will transgress: He will be abused for nothing.
eye: Meaning, he that is covetous.
fat: Will have all things in abundance.
